name: OpenColo

profile.reading: Per OpenColo own site, this Santa Clara, California facility sits at 3223 Kenneth St and totals 71,000 square feet of data center space. The page states 9 MW of total capacity with 4.5 MW coming soon, phrasing this session found ambiguous between current operating capacity and a near term addition, so it is recorded as a capacity note rather than critical_it_mw. The facility features 2N plus 1 reliability with dual utility feeds, 2750kW/3437kVA diesel generators, lithium ion batteries, N+1 indirect evaporative cooling, a 100 percent uptime SLA, and SOC 2 Type II certification.
